profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Results-oriented Software Developer with 6+ years of experience designing, building, and implementing robust software solutions. Possessing strong communication and collaboration skills, I excel at bridging technical complexities with business objectives. Proven expertise in Java, Spring, Hibernate, and cloud technologies.

With a focus on full-stack development, my recent role at Excellus BCBS saw me enhance application usability significantly. By engineering and integrating advanced portlets and RESTful APIs, our team increased satisfaction metrics and streamlined Agile processes to deliver high-quality software solutions.

My expertise in Java, Spring MVC, and Hibernate, combined with front-end technologies such as HTML and JavaScript, has been pivotal in boosting application performance and data retrieval efficiency. Collaborating closely with Product Managers and Business Analysts, we've achieved substantial improvements in application quality and user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
· Architected and integrated 10+ portlets using Java 8, Spring MVC, and Struts within the Liferay framework, resulting in a 40% improvement in application usability.
· Designed and developed REST API architectures to facilitate seamless data exchange and backend integration.
· Developed responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, and Node.js, increasing user satisfaction metrics by 35%.
· Optimized data retrieval efficiency by 45% by implementing a robust persistence layer with Hibernate/JPA to manage Oracle database interactions.
· Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and Azure DevOps, automating build, test, and deployment processes to accelerate release cycles.
· Collaborated in an Agile environment with Product Managers and Business Analysts to refine requirements, reducing bug reports by 20% through rigorous code optimization and testing.
· Mentored and onboarded 3 new engineers, establishing standardized coding practices and accelerating project delivery timelines.
· Earned Top Contributor Award for leading initiatives that improved the digital billing and payment experience for members and groups.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
· Architected and implemented scalable enterprise solutions using Docker, Java, Spring MVC, REST API, Hibernate, and JavaScript, resulting in a 30% performance boost and 25% reduction in load times.
· Managed the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for small business applications, achieving a 25% decrease in development time and a 15% improvement in project delivery rates.
· Engineered automated tracking and billing systems for non-technical clients, increasing invoicing efficiency by 35% and data accuracy by 40%.
· Provided technical consultancy and weekly project updates, leading to a 25% increase in client satisfaction and a 15% increase in repeat business.

positions.title: Assistant system engineer
positions.description:
· Developed m-Pesa, a core financial transaction platform, from the ground up using Java, Hibernate, and JAX-WS, successfully supporting over 1 million daily transactions.
· Engineered an in-house MVC framework based on Java Reflection, ensuring high modularity and system scalability.
· Optimized system communication by 25% through the implementation of JMS (Java Message Service) and MDB (Message Driven Beans).
· Authored high-quality, production-ready code with 100% test coverage using JUnit, maintaining a record of zero critical production bugs.
· Developed complex PL/SQL scripts for highly customizable reporting tools, accelerating executive decision-making speed by 20%.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Introduced senior citizens who were previously non users of computer technology to a vibrant love and understanding of the computer. Core curriculum included computer basics, Microsoft Office Suite software, Email, Social media and Digital technology.

•	Created course syllabus.
•	Progressed senior citizens from an introductory level to an intermediate level of computer technology.
•       Achieved a 100% success rate of senior citizens being able to use the computer and MS Word software to produce business letters, send emails with attachments, and comfortably explore and engage on social media websites.

projects.title: Simulation tool for CPU Scoreboard
projects.description: Built a tool in Java to simulate scoreboard for APEX CPU. It is a tool used for tracking instruction state and predicting the completion cycle of instruction.

projects.title: Smart Phone Sound Controller
projects.description: Developed an android app using Beacon technology. When the user enters a room that has a pre-configured beacon transmitter, the app turns the phone to silent mode.
